messages:
Mara Chen: Quick heads-up — OraWave (mid-enterprise) renewal in 18 days. Usage down ~60% last 30d. Private deploy still blocked on network firewall. Risk: downgrade from Pro to Starter unless we get traction.
Samir Patel: Thanks. Is billing flagged as at-risk? any escalation on contract terms?
Mara Chen: Not yet flagged. Finance asked me to try a 'precision save' before raising. They want a short, measurable win we can point to. Customer says main blocker is throughput on their batch embed pipeline and lack of clear onboarding milestones.
Devin Ortiz: I can run a focused perf triage for the batch embedding flow tomorrow. ETA 24h.
Lina Gomez: I'll offer a tailored enablement session (30m) with their infra lead and provide a step-by-step async checklist.
Mara Chen: Proposed 'precision save' steps (lean playbook):
``` 
1) Immediate: 30-min enablement + access to perf triage (Devin). Owner: Lina / Devin. Date target: within 3 business days.
2) Mid: Temporary usage uplift incentive — 20% discount for the next billing cycle conditionally tied to activation of the batched embed path.
3) Fallback: Structured downgrade path that preserves data retention and a gentle price step-down + pinned re-onboarding offer.
4) Measurable success criteria: +30% weekly usage vs baseline OR completed deployment of batched pipeline within 2 weeks.
``` 
Mara Chen: Also attaching the 'success-gap matrix' I sketched in thread — short table of blockers vs mitigations (see below):
- Blocker: Private network firewall config -> Mitigation: step-by-step port list + sample iptables rules. Owner: Lina.
- Blocker: KV cache misconfig -> Mitigation: Devin to propose config + quick patch.
Samir Patel: +1. Will support the discount ask. Finance ok with a 20% conditional concession if success criteria met.
ops-bot: Note: a ticket was created #CS-4542 and assigned to Devin.
Devin Ortiz: Confirmed. I'll post triage findings into the ticket and into an internal playbook link.
Mara Chen: Customer-facing save message I'll send (short):
"We want to ensure your deployment meets your SLAs. Can we schedule a 30-min session this week? If we can get the batched embed pipeline working, we can extend a temporary 20% incentive conditional on demonstrable activation."
Lina Gomez: Drafting the enablement checklist now. Will include exact port numbers, nginx config snippet, and a minimal validation curl test.
Samir Patel: After session, if they still choose to downgrade we should present the 'grace downgrade' flow: preserve embeddings, export tooling, and re-onboard credit. We don't want churn by surprise.
Mara Chen: Agreed. I'll ping legal for a short amendment template for the incentive and the grace downgrade anchor.
Lina Gomez: ETA for checklist: EOD today.
Mara Chen: Great. Next check-in in 48h. If we get the enablement session scheduled I'll add the short notes to the renewal owner field and update risk to 'managed'. :thumbsup:
Devin Ortiz: I'll drop preliminary perf numbers in CS-4542 within 8h.
Samir Patel: Thanks team. Mara, add me into any customer comms and I can join the session.
Mara Chen: Will do. Thanks all.
